corpus.note: The designation is expressed over the executable, SHA-256-pinned LLP 0051 D5 conformance corpus — the corpus the coverage runner actually measures. Option B's reference-app framing is carried by the corpus itself: the todo-v2/get/expr/reject cases are the frozen executable projections of the reference-app durable-mutation demands. Every corpus case is either designated below or excluded below with a reason; the partition is total and validated by the runner.

rationale: Everyday agent-app operations: field toggle, patch (including missing-row softness), single-row delete, guarded read, null/equality/default/string/conditional/arithmetic expression semantics, and the two argument-validation refusal behaviors agents hit constantly.
passRule: 100% of the designated cases must be locally admitted (plan-shape classification 'ready') and complete the real-browser suite with browser-vs-Node exact normalized outcomes after IndexedDB read-back. A designated case refused by admission fails this axis — the designation names the OPERATION as common-path; whether the shipped ceiling admits it is exactly what the gate measures.

exclusions.reason: Authoritative-value minting is server-owned per LLP 0129 decision 10, and optimistic creation is Move 4's deliberately-deferred machinery — local IR execution of creates is out of the evaluator's obligation by ratified design.
Prediction is never authority (LLP 0155 P4): auth-guarded writes are adjudicated server-side and are not browser common-path local executions.
Batch/fanout/multi-step machinery held behind deliberate effect ceilings; not everyday agent-app common path.
Bounds and semantic-depth cases are covered by the gate's ≥90% semantic axis; they are conformance depth, not common-path operations.

corpusObservations: todo-v2-delete-todo inspected 2026-08-07 before freezing: its plan is exactly one Delete step addressing a single row by Arg id with return_value ChangedCount — a plain single-row delete, not a cascade or filtered delete. It is designated as the corpus's single-row-delete operation.

As of the 2026-08-06 coverage receipt, todo-v2-delete-todo is refused by the shipped plan-shape admission (SNAPBACK_PLAN_EFFECT_CEILING under the M1 Insert/Get/Guard/Patch ceiling). It is designated anyway: the designation names the operation as common-path, and surfacing that ceiling collision is the gate doing its job.
